title: Build objects from compact generators by a homotopy colimit
statement: Let C be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] with set-indexed coproducts and a set (E_i) of compact objects [def-pc-compact-object] whose coproduct is a generator [def-pc-generators]. Every object Y of C is a sequential homotopy colimit of objects X_n such that X_1 is a coproduct of shifts of the E_i and each transition X_n \to X_{n+1} fits into a distinguished triangle Z_n \to X_n \to X_{n+1} \to Z_n[1], where Z_n is a coproduct of shifts of the E_i.
